D: A huge pop star's second album flops, and a camera crew films every moment of the fall.
P: Serve the snacks when Conner's tour kicks off.
S: Tour rider tropical fruit with chilli salt
Mango, pineapple, watermelon and papaya wedges with chilli salt

A big platter of chilled mango, pineapple, watermelon and papaya, sprinkled with chilli lime salt and served with lime wedges. Peel and slice 2 mangoes, half a pineapple, a quarter watermelon and half a papaya into long wedges. Chill on a big platter for 30 minutes. Grind 1 tbsp sea salt flakes with 1 tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp caster sugar and the zest of 2 limes. Just before serving, squeeze over the juice of 1 lime and sprinkle with the chilli salt. Serve with extra lime wedges.
Buttermilk fried chicken tenders on small soft buns

Buttermilk fried chicken pieces in soft brioche slider buns with crunchy slaw, pickles and a sriracha mayonnaise. Soak 500g chicken tenderloins in 200ml buttermilk with salt for 30 minutes. Toss in 150g plain flour mixed with 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder. Shallow fry at 180C for 4 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 1 tbsp sriracha. Toss 2 cups shredded cabbage with 1 tbsp vinegar. Fill 8 toasted brioche slider buns with chicken, slaw, pickles and the mayo.
M: Style Boyz fish tacos with mango salsa
Chilli lime grilled fish in tortillas with fresh mango salsa

Chilli and lime grilled white fish in warm corn tortillas with fresh mango salsa, shredded cabbage, avocado crema and coriander. Rub 600g firm white fish fillets with 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin, the zest of 1 lime and 1 tbsp oil. Grill 3 minutes a side and flake. Dice 1 mango, half a red onion and 1 red chilli and toss with lime juice and coriander. Blend 1 avocado with 100g sour cream and lime juice. Warm 12 small corn tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with shredded cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.
W: Round vanilla bean butter cookies flooded with grey and silver icing, piped with record grooves and a little label in the middle. Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, then add 1 egg yolk, 1 tsp vanilla bean paste and 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm and cut 16 rounds with a 8cm cutter. Bake at 170C for 12 minutes and cool. Mix 300g icing sugar with 3 tbsp water and a drop of black colouring to make grey. Flood each cookie, let it set, then pipe thin circles for grooves and a small coloured label in the centre.
K: Gin muddled with cucumber, mint and lime, topped with soda

Gin muddled with cucumber, mint and lime, topped with sparkling water over ice for a crisp backstage spritz. Leave out the gin for a mocktail. Thinly slice 1 Lebanese cucumber. In a jug, muddle 8 cucumber slices with a handful of mint leaves, the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar syrup. Add 160ml gin and stir. Fill 4 wine glasses with ice and the rest of the cucumber slices. Strain the gin mix into the glasses and top each with 120ml sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.

dishes.n: Tour rider tropical fruit with chilli salt
dishes.make_ahead: Slice the fruit and chill the platter, covered, up to 4 hours ahead; make the chilli salt up to 1 week ahead and add the lime juice at the last minute

steps.text: Peel and slice the mangoes, pineapple, watermelon and papaya into long wedges and arrange on a big platter.
Chill the platter.
Grind the salt with the chilli, sugar and lime zest.
Just before serving, squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with the chilli salt. Serve with lime wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk up to 1 day ahead in the fridge; mix the sriracha mayo up to 2 days ahead and fry just before serving

steps.text: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk with salt.
Toss the chicken in the flour mixed with paprika and garlic powder.
Shallow fry in the vegetable oil at 180C, turning once, until golden and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Toss the cabbage with the vinegar.
Toast the buns and fill with chicken, slaw, pickles and sriracha mayo.

veg.make_ahead: Tear and soak the mushrooms in the buttermilk up to 4 hours ahead; mix the sriracha mayo up to 2 days ahead and fry at the last minute

steps.text: Tear the oyster mushrooms into 8 large clusters and soak in the buttermilk with salt.
Toss the mushrooms in the flour mixed with paprika and garlic powder, pressing it on well.
Shallow fry in the vegetable oil at 180C, turning once, until deep golden and crisp.
Mix the mayonnaise with the sriracha. Toss the cabbage with the vinegar.
Toast the buns and fill with the crispy mushrooms, slaw, pickles and sriracha mayo.

dishes.n: Style Boyz fish tacos with mango salsa
dishes.make_ahead: Make the mango salsa up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; blend the crema and grill the fish on the night

steps.text: Rub the fish with the chilli powder, cumin, lime zest and oil.
Grill the fish, turning once, then flake.
Toss the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice and coriander for the salsa.
Blend the avocado with the sour cream and lime juice into a crema.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

veg.n: Style Boyz haloumi tacos with mango salsa
veg.make_ahead: Make the mango salsa and shred the cabbage up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; blend the crema and grill the haloumi on the night

steps.text: Rub the haloumi with the chilli powder, cumin, lime zest and oil.
Grill the haloumi, turning once, until golden, then cut into strips.
Toss the mango, onion, chilli, lime juice and coriander for the salsa.
Blend the avocado with the sour cream and lime juice into a crema.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with cabbage, haloumi, salsa and crema.

dishes.make_ahead: Baked cookies up to 3 days, iced cookies up to 2 days in an airtight container

ingredients.item: pack food colouring (black and one bright colour)

steps.text: Beat the butter with some of the icing sugar, then add the egg yolk, vanilla and flour to make a dough.
Chill the dough.
Roll out thin and cut into rounds with an 8cm cutter.
Bake at 170C and cool completely.
Mix the remaining icing sugar with water and a drop of black colouring to make grey icing. Flood each cookie.
Let the icing set, then pipe thin circles for grooves and a small coloured label in the centre.

dishes.make_ahead: Muddle the cucumber, mint, lime juice and syrup and stir in the gin up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; strain over ice and top with sparkling water to serve

steps.text: Muddle some cucumber slices with the mint, juice of two limes and sugar syrup in a jug. Add the gin and stir.
Fill wine glasses with ice and the remaining cucumber.
Strain the gin mix into the glasses and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.

af.make_ahead: Muddle the cucumber, mint, lime juice and syrup and stir in the non-alcoholic gin up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled; strain over ice and top with sparkling water to serve

Fill wine glasses with ice and the remaining cucumber.
Strain the mix into the glasses and top with sparkling water. Garnish with mint and a lime wheel.
